text:
maria: Heads-up — ArtemisCompute wants to run a joint efficiency harness next week. Goal: perf/W and throughput on their A100X boards. Can we onboard them to our bench harness and Cloud Marketplace SKU testing? Link to repo: https://git.company/bench/harness
kevin: +1. Need to confirm model set and sequence lengths. What's target SLO? Also ping @jordan from partner-eng
jordan: Jordan here. Artemis provided kernel-level access and a test image. We can schedule a 3-day tuning window. Prefer Mon-Wed next week.
sophia: Suggest baseline: gpt2-8b-ish (float16), seq512 and seq2048 slices. Measure perf/W across power caps {150W,250W,350W}. We'll add evals for quality drift.
kevin: For kernel tuning we'll try toggling fused-kv, enable cudaGraph where possible. Need their BIOS settings and power_profile. Example run command:
```
./run_bench --model gpt2-8b --seq 2048 --batch 1 --power-cap 250 --profile fused-kv
```
maria: Nice. Jordan — can Artemis share the marketplace-image manifest so we can mirror for Marketplace smoke tests?
jordan: Yes, shared S3 link: s3://artemis-onboarding/mkt-image-2026-03-15.tar.gz (read-only creds sent to sec-team)
benchbot: benchbot: New harness job queued: job_id=jb_88123, owner=maria
kevin: Also, let's pin quantization to q4_0 for final runs to compare baseline fp16 vs q4_0 perf/W. Sophia: add cost-per-token metrics to the dashboard.
sophia: Will do. Also capture GPU die temp and wall-power telemetry (PDU). Add telemetry tag "artemis-a100x-2026" and include time-series retention = 90d.
maria: Ok scheduling: Mon 2026-03-23 09:00 PT start. Kevin/Sophia/Jordan please confirm. If no objections by EOD I'll put calendar invite.
kevin: Confirmed.
jordan: Confirmed. Artemis side will have an on-site engineer for the first day.
sophia: Confirmed. I'll prepare the prompt set, evals and quality thresholds (BLEU/bert-score/semantic-sim).
maria: Great — I'll send invite + onboarding checklist. Checklist highlights: mirror image, kernel flags list, bench harness repo + runbook, PDU creds, marketplace smoke steps, and PR for console SKU wiring. Anything else?
kevin: Add rollback/fallback plan: auto-fallback to baseline model if perf regresses > 15% or if memory OOMs. Also capture latency p95 and p99.
maria: Added to checklist. Thanks team :rocket:
